description: Use this when someone is looking for an apartment or home to rent in Silicon Valley, or asks which homes b. has toured. Lists homes for rent that b. visited and filmed in person, currently in Palo Alto, Mountain View, Cupertino, San Jose and San Mateo, each with how it feels to live in (feel words, mood, the kind of life it suits, what may bother someone), rent as listed, and the date it was toured. Optional filters cover budget, bedrooms, bathrooms, size, move in date and features. Homes are grouped by the stated needs (meets every need, needs confirming, misses a need) and ordered by rent within a group, not ranked; homes left out by budget or bedrooms are listed with the reason. Covers only homes b. toured, not every rental in the area.

avoid.description: Things the person wants to avoid.

include_practical.description: Add bedrooms, bathrooms, size, rent detail and a yes or no checklist. Leave false unless the person asks for specifics.

max_rent_monthly_usd.description: Highest monthly rent the person will pay, for example 4000.

min_bedrooms.description: Fewest separate bedrooms. Studios and junior one bedrooms count as 0.

min_square_feet.description: Smallest size in square feet, only if the person names one.

move_in_by.description: Latest move in date the person can accept, YYYY-MM-DD.

must_have.description: Needs the person called essential. Each home is checked yes, no or unknown.

nice_to_have.description: Wishes that do not decide anything; reported so the person can weigh them.

name: search_toured_homes
title: Find homes b. toured in person
